_meta.source: Curated offline cache of widely-known drug-drug interactions. Validated against RxNorm, DrugBank (open), FDA PI, Drugs.com. NLM RxNav API can extend this at runtime when network available.
_meta.disclaimer: Interactions list is non-exhaustive. Patient should always consult pharmacist + prescriber. Severity grades follow Drugs.com convention: contraindicated > major > moderate > minor.

interactions.mechanism: Both increase bleeding risk; aspirin inhibits platelet function while warfarin inhibits coagulation
interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination unless cardiologist specifically prescribes. Monitor INR + bleeding signs

interactions.mechanism: NSAID increases bleeding risk + may displace warfarin from plasma protein binding
interactions.recommendation: Avoid; use acetaminophen for pain instead

interactions.mechanism: Same as ibuprofen — NSAID bleeding risk
interactions.recommendation: Avoid

interactions.mechanism: Amiodarone inhibits CYP2C9 + CYP3A4, raising warfarin levels
interactions.recommendation: Reduce warfarin dose 30-50%, monitor INR weekly

interactions.mechanism: Fluoroquinolones may potentiate warfarin via CYP inhibition + gut flora disruption
interactions.recommendation: Monitor INR within 3-5 days of starting

interactions.mechanism: Trimethoprim inhibits CYP2C9, raising warfarin
interactions.recommendation: Alternative antibiotic preferred, or monitor INR closely

interactions.mechanism: Rifampin induces CYP2C9 + CYP3A4, lowering warfarin → subtherapeutic INR
interactions.recommendation: Significant warfarin dose increase needed; monitor INR

interactions.mechanism: Dual antiplatelet therapy — intentional in ACS post-PCI, otherwise bleeding risk
interactions.recommendation: Use only if cardiologist prescribes; otherwise avoid duplication

interactions.mechanism: Omeprazole inhibits CYP2C19 which activates clopidogrel → reduced antiplatelet effect
interactions.recommendation: Use pantoprazole or famotidine instead

interactions.mechanism: ACE inhibitor + potassium supplement → hyperkalemia risk
interactions.recommendation: Monitor serum K+ regularly; avoid combination if possible

interactions.mechanism: ACE inhibitor + potassium-sparing diuretic → hyperkalemia
interactions.recommendation: Monitor K+, creatinine; use with caution

interactions.mechanism: ARB + potassium → hyperkalemia
interactions.recommendation: Monitor K+ closely

interactions.mechanism: ARB + potassium-sparing diuretic → hyperkalemia
interactions.recommendation: Monitor K+ closely

interactions.mechanism: Macrolide inhibits CYP3A4 → statin levels increase → rhabdomyolysis risk
interactions.recommendation: Hold statin during antibiotic course

interactions.mechanism: Amiodarone inhibits CYP3A4 → simvastatin levels → rhabdomyolysis
interactions.recommendation: Limit simvastatin to 20mg max with amiodarone; consider atorvastatin/rosuvastatin

interactions.mechanism: Grapefruit inhibits intestinal CYP3A4 → statin levels increase
interactions.recommendation: Avoid grapefruit while on simvastatin

interactions.mechanism: Same as simvastatin
interactions.recommendation: Limit grapefruit consumption

interactions.mechanism: Both vasodilate via NO/cGMP → severe hypotension, cardiovascular collapse
interactions.recommendation: Do NOT combine. Wait 24h between sildenafil and any nitrate

interactions.mechanism: Both serotonergic — serotonin syndrome risk + tramadol metabolism affected by CYP2D6
interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination; if necessary, monitor for serotonin syndrome (agitation, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia)

interactions.mechanism: Same — serotonin syndrome risk
interactions.recommendation: Avoid; if needed, use lowest effective doses + monitor

interactions.mechanism: Two SSRIs together — serotonin syndrome
interactions.recommendation: Do not combine; titrate switching with 2-week washout if changing

interactions.mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal lithium clearance → toxicity
interactions.recommendation: Use acetaminophen instead; if NSAID needed, monitor lithium levels

interactions.mechanism: Thiazide diuretics decrease lithium clearance
interactions.recommendation: Monitor lithium closely; consider alternative diuretic

interactions.mechanism: Amiodarone raises digoxin levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition
interactions.recommendation: Reduce digoxin dose 50%, monitor levels

interactions.mechanism: Reduced gastric acid impairs levothyroxine absorption
interactions.recommendation: Take levothyroxine 30+ min before omeprazole, monitor TSH

interactions.mechanism: Both folate antagonists → severe bone marrow suppression
interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination

interactions.mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal methotrexate clearance → toxicity
interactions.recommendation: Avoid in high-dose methotrexate; low-dose RA monitoring OK with caution

interactions.mechanism: Both CYP3A4 inducers — complex interactions; phenytoin levels may rise or fall
interactions.recommendation: Monitor levels of both

interactions.mechanism: Carbamazepine induces UGT → lamotrigine levels fall; need higher lamotrigine dose
interactions.recommendation: Titrate lamotrigine slowly, monitor levels and seizure control
